example.question: For each city, show how many customers signed up after 2020 and how many orders those customers placed.
example.reference: SELECT c.city, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers_after_2020, COUNT(o.id) AS orders_from_them FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.signup_year > 2020 GROUP BY c.city
example.model:
SELECT city FROM customers 
WHERE signup_year > 2020 GROUP BY city
